eyebrow: The School of 2036 · Built on Google Classroom
heroBody: Tajriba turns any school subject into real missions: measure your building with its shadow, share a pizza fairly, interview your grandparents. Arzino, your AI coach, guides you every step of the way.
heroFoot: XP, streaks and badges for every mission you finish

missions.tank: How much water fits in your roof tank?
missions.ramp: Is your staircase safe for a ramp?

howTitle: From “When will I ever use this?” to “I did it!”

how.s1Body: A real problem from your home or neighborhood, with a one-minute lesson to get you started.
how.s2Body: Measure, build, cook or ask. Every mission is safety-checked and approved by your teacher.
how.s3Body: Add photos and explain your work in your own voice. Arzino reviews it and asks you one follow-up question.
how.s4Body: A classmate reviews your work. You earn XP and badges, and the next skill unlocks.

game.xpBody: Every mission you finish brings you closer to the next level.
game.streakBody: Learn a little every day and keep your flame alive.
game.peerBody: Review a classmate's work with Arzino's checklist and earn XP for helping.
game.mapBody: Master one skill and the next one lights up.
game.shameBody: If something isn't right yet, we show you how to fix it.
game.shameQuote: Almost there! Here's what to fix.

arzinoTitle: Your AI coach is a little Lebanese cedar
arzinoBody: Arzino guides students without doing the work for them. He gives hints instead of answers, asks a follow-up question to check real understanding, and celebrates every win.

arzinoPoints.hints: Hints that guide you, never the answer
arzinoPoints.voice: Speaks and listens in Arabic and English
arzinoPoints.safe: Never sees students' names or emails

campusTitle: A virtual school to explore together
campusBody: Students walk around a 2D campus, meet their classmates and step into rooms to study or take exams.

campus.walkBody: Move with the arrow keys or a tap, and wave to your classmates.
campus.studyBody: Invite a classmate to a room and talk it through with Arzino's discussion cards.
campus.examBody: Arzino asks the questions and you answer out loud. Your teacher can listen in live.

rolesTitle: One app for the whole school community

roles.studentBody: Complete missions, level up and help your classmates learn.
roles.teacherBody: Import your classes from Google Classroom, approve missions drafted by AI and see who needs help.
roles.parentBody: Get a weekly summary in your language and do family missions together.
roles.schoolBody: Approve teachers and follow mastery across every class and subject.

visionTitle: Don't just improve school. Rethink it.

vision.toD: A personal coach for every student

roadmapTitle: Works with the tools your school already uses
ctaBody: Sign in with your school Google account. Your classes will already be there.
footer: Built for the Experia Education Hackathon · Beirut 2026
